fields.statement: At 6c7b06c5 I read the diff: .github/workflows/ci.yml adds workflow_dispatch with a required sha input, run-name 'CI ${{ inputs.sha || github.event.pull_request.title }}', concurrency group ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || inputs.sha }}, and checkout ref ${{ inputs.sha || github.sha }}. Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/ciworkflow/...: TestCIRunsOnPullRequestsAndDispatch, TestCICheckoutAndRunName and TestCICancelsStaleRuns all PASS. In a scratch copy I mutated ci.yml six ways (workflow_dispatch renamed, required: false, ref without inputs.sha, run-name without inputs.sha, group without the inputs.sha fallback, pull_request replaced by push) and each made the test fail. The package sits under go test ./..., which make test and so make check run.
